module: GE extension `core_environment`: single entry point to read and modify the level environment (time of day, clouds, wind, fog, precipitation, gravity, temperature) and to load ground models (art/groundmodels.json + the level's groundModels/*.json). It acts on scene objects (TimeOfDay, CloudLayer, LevelInfo, Precipitation) found by class, turns night lights on/off according to the time, and sends the state to the UI. A modder uses it to change the time, wind or gravity by script, or to react to `onEnvironmentChanged`.
usage:
extensions.load('core_environment')
-- noon (time = 0), day lasting 30 real minutes, clock running
core_environment.setTimeOfDay({time = 0, play = true, dayLength = 1800})
core_environment.setGravity(-1.62)            -- m/s², negative = downwards
core_environment.setGroundWind(5, 0, 0)       -- m/s in world frame
core_environment.setFogDensity(0.002)         -- raw LevelInfo value
print(core_environment.getTemperatureK() - 273.15)
notes: Time: `time` is normalized 0..1 and wraps (modulo 1). 0 = noon (key `noon`), 0.25 = roughly sunset (`sunset` 0.245), 0.5 = midnight (`night`), 0.775 = sunrise. To convert a clock time: time = (seconds_since_midnight / 86400 - 0.5) % 1 (formula used by syncTimeToRealClock).
`dayLength` = real seconds for a full day/night cycle (presets: 900, 1800, 7200, 86400). `play` enables time flow (also writes the legacy `animate` field).

Gravity: m/s², NEGATIVE value to go downwards (-9.81 by default, fallback of getGravity). 0 = weightlessness, +9.81 = inverted gravity. setGravity updates LevelInfo.gravity AND sends obj:setGravity to all vehicles (queueAllObjectLua).

Wind: setGroundWind(x,y,z) is a world vec3 in m/s (inferred from code: passed as is to be:setGroundWind and obj:setWind). setWindSpeed/getWindSpeed act on CloudLayer.windSpeed (cloud movement speed), not on the physical wind of vehicles.

Fog: LevelInfo.fogDensity is a very small raw value; the UI manipulates fogDensity*1000 (getState returns fogDensity*1000, applyStateNow divides by 1000). The setFogDensity/getFogDensity functions use the raw value. fogAtmosphereHeight: fog atmosphere height (UI lerp range ~0..2000, inferred from lerpRanges).

Clouds: altitudes in kilometers (`...Km`), coverage of CloudLayer (lerp range 0..3 in setState), cirrus coverage/density are the cirrusCoverage/cirrusDensity fields of CloudLayer. The `...ByID` variants target a specific CloudLayer by scene object id; they do not emit onEnvironmentChanged and ignore enableChanges.

Temperature: getTemperatureK() returns kelvins (sea level temperature sent to the engine via be:setSeaLevelTemperatureK). The level curve (LevelInfo:getTemperatureCurveC, in °C, points {t 0..1, °C}) is evaluated according to the time at each onUpdate. setTemperatureProfile works in °C, clamped to -50..60 (UI); the override curve is clamped to -273.15..200 °C at normalization.
enableChanges(false) blocks all writes to the scene (but the onEnvironmentChanged hooks are still emitted for most setters). Used by scenarios to freeze the sky.
Emitted hook: `onEnvironmentChanged(changedTable)` on each setter (except during a global state update). UI events: `EnvironmentStateUpdate` (full state) and `EnvironmentCanUpdateChanged` (boolean).
Deprecated functions that only log a warning and return nil: get/setShadowDistance, get/setSkyBrightness, all get/set...GradientFile, get/setFogDensityOffset, get/setCloudExposureByID.

Inconsistencies: setFogDensityOffset is exported (M.setFogDensityOffset) but absent from the automatic list; setFogAtmosphereHeight does not emit onEnvironmentChanged unlike setFogDensity; setPrecipitation emits no hook and ignores enableChanges; the internal setTemperatureK is not exported (no direct temperature setting, only via setTemperatureProfile). onVehicleResetted and onVehicleSpawned are both bound to applyGroundWind (re-applies the wind to vehicles).

dependencies.desc: {'core_solarTimeOfDay'}: extension loaded before this one (solar computation: night window, sunrise/sunset events).

groundModels.type: table<string, {cdata: any, isAlias: boolean, parent: string}>
groundModels.desc: Known ground models, keys in UPPERCASE. cdata = C++ ground_model structure; isAlias/parent indicate whether the entry is an alias of another model. Rebuilt by reloadGroundModels.

loadedGroundModelFiles.desc: Paths of the loaded ground model JSON files (common + level). Used by onFilesChanged to detect a hot modification.

defaultTimeOfDayOptions.desc: List {key, value, label} of key moments: sunrise 0.775, morning 0.825, earlyNoon 0.9, noon 0, lateNoon 0.1, afternoon 0.175, evening 0.23, sunset 0.245, night 0.5. label = translation key.

defaultSolarTimeOfDayOptions.desc: Deep copy of defaultTimeOfDayOptions, base for the astronomically computed options.

timeOfDayKeyToTime.desc: Table key -> time value for the default key moments (noon -> 0, night -> 0.5, …).

gravityPresets.desc: Presets {key, title, value} in m/s² (earth -9.81, moon -1.62, mars -3.71, sun -274, jupiter -24.92, neptune -11.15, saturn -10.44, uranus -8.87, venus -8.87, mercury -3.7, pluto -0.58, zero 0, inverted earth 9.81).

dayCyclePresets.desc: {speed, seconds}: real seconds per day/night cycle: fast 900, normal 1800, slow 7200, realtime 86400.

simSpeedPresets.desc: {key, label, value}: simulation slow-motion factors (value = divisor: 1 real time, 2 = 1/2x, 4, 10, 25, 50, 100, 1000).

getState.desc: Builds the full environment state. Keys: TimeOfDay fields (time, play, dayLength, startTime, latitude, longitude, year, month, day, utcOffset, dstRule, celestialProfile), windSpeed, groundWind, cloudCover, cloudWindDirection, cloudAltitudeKm, cloudWeatherOffsetKm, cloudCirrus*, fogDensity (x1000), fogAtmosphereHeight, numOfDrops, gravity, temperatureC (°C), temperatureProfile, temperatureCurveOverrideC.

returns.desc: State table (never nil in practice because temperatureCurveOverrideC is always present).

setState.desc: Applies a state (same format as getState). Emits onEnvironmentChanged. With lerpSeconds > 0, cloudCover, fogDensity, fogAtmosphereHeight and time are interpolated (smootherstep curve, shorter duration if the gap is small, minimum 0.12 s); the other fields are applied immediately.

state.desc: Partial or full state; fogDensity expected x1000; time optional (without time the clock is not moved).

lerpSeconds.desc: Maximum transition duration in real seconds; nil or <= 0 = immediate.

requestState.desc: Alias of sendState: sends the current state to the UI (guihooks EnvironmentStateUpdate) and the state of the canChange flag.

getInitState.desc: Copy of the state captured at level load (onClientPostStartMission), with temperatureProfile computed on the level's original curve and possibly authoredDayLength.

reset.desc: Re-reads the level's temperature curve, removes the temperature override, notifies the UI and reloads the ground models. Also serves as onInit.

enableChanges.desc: Allows or forbids environment modifications and notifies the UI.

enabled.desc: false = the setters no longer write to the scene.

canChange.desc: Indicates whether environment modifications are allowed.

returns.desc: State of the flag set by enableChanges (true by default).

getTimeOfDay.desc: Reads the TimeOfDay scene object and returns a shared state (the same table is reused on every call: copy before keeping it).

returns.desc: {time, play, dayLength, startTime, latitude, longitude, year, month, day, utcOffset, dstRule, celestialProfile}; nil if there is no TimeOfDay object (main menu).

setTimeOfDay.desc: Applies time-of-day fields to the TimeOfDay object. Does nothing if the table contains no known field. Emits onEnvironmentChanged and updates the night lights if time is provided. Changing year/month/day/latitude forces a recomputation of the sun position.

timeOfDay.desc: Optional fields: time (0..1, 0 = noon, 0.5 = midnight), play (boolean), dayLength (real s), startTime, latitude, longitude (degrees, inferred from code), year, month, day, utcOffset (hours), dstRule, celestialProfile (name, reloads core_celestial).

cycleTimeOfDay.desc: Cycles the time through three values: if time < 0.2 -> 0.23 (evening), if time >= 0.5 -> 0.05 (day), otherwise -> 0.5 (night).

getLightState.desc: World lighting state: day or night. Returns {time, phase = 'day'|'night', isNight, nightLightsActive, nightStart, nightEnd}. nightLightsActive reflects what the engine actually applied.

returns.desc: nil if there is no TimeOfDay.

refreshnightLightsObjects.desc: Scans the scene for lights to turn on at night (nightLight field), lights with day/night intensity (dayIntensity/nightIntensity), and emissive TSStatics (nightEmissive or linked to a light by the `child` field), then applies the current state. To be called after adding such objects during gameplay.

getTimeOfDayOptions.desc: Time-of-day options adapted to the level, computed astronomically (core_solarTimeOfDay) from the level's options (core_levels).

getSolarTimeOfDayOptions.desc: Moment options computed for the state's solar position and date, from the default options.

getSolarTimeOfDayValue.desc: Time value for a moment key (e.g. 'sunrise') with the state's date/position.

key.desc: Key: sunrise, morning, earlyNoon, noon, lateNoon, afternoon, evening, sunset, night.

getTimeOfDayValueForNormalizedTime.desc: Converts a normalized time via core_solarTimeOfDay.timeFromNormalizedTime for the given state (exact meaning defined in core_solarTimeOfDay).

syncTimeToRealClock.desc: Sets the game time to the computer's real local time (os.date('*t')), keeping the play state.

syncTimeToRealClockUtc.desc: Sets the game time AND date to the real UTC instant converted to the level's time zone (utcOffset/dstRule).

getDayCycleSeconds.desc: Duration in real seconds of the day/night cycle for a preset.

getAuthoredDayLength.desc: Searches the *.level.json files in the level folder (excluding /scenarios/) for a dayLength value explicitly written in the TimeOfDay object (the engine fills in dayLength even if absent from the file).

setGravity.desc: Sets gravity: writes LevelInfo.gravity (for future spawns) and sends obj:setGravity to all vehicles. Emits onEnvironmentChanged({gravity}).

grav.desc: Acceleration in m/s², negative downwards (-9.81 = Earth). nil/false: ignored; 0 is accepted.

returns.desc: m/s² (negative downwards); -9.81 if LevelInfo is absent.

setGroundWind.desc: Sets the ground wind applied to the world and to all vehicles (obj:setWind + be:setGroundWind).

....desc: A vec3, or 3 numbers x, y, z (m/s, world frame, inferred from code).

getGroundWind.desc: Returns the internal ground wind vec3 (direct reference, do not modify).

setWindSpeed.desc: Sets CloudLayer.windSpeed of the first CloudLayer in the scene.

windSpeed.desc: Cloud wind speed (unit of the engine field, not specified in the code).

getWindSpeed.desc: Reads CloudLayer.windSpeed of the first CloudLayer.

setCloudCover.desc: Sets CloudLayer.coverage of the first CloudLayer and cancels an ongoing state transition.

getCloudCover.desc: Reads CloudLayer.coverage of the first CloudLayer.

setCloudWindDirection.desc: Sets CloudLayer.windDirection (Point2F) of the first CloudLayer; only x and y are used.

....desc: A vec3 or two numbers x, y.

returns.desc: vec3(x, y, 0); nil without a CloudLayer.

getCloudWeatherOffsetKm.desc: Offset of the cloud weather map (CloudLayer.getWeatherOffsetKm).

returns.desc: Offset in km; nil if the C++ API is not available.

setCloudWeatherOffsetKm.desc: Offsets the cloud weather map. Emits onEnvironmentChanged.

....desc: A vec3 or 3 numbers x, y, z in km.

returns.desc: true if applied, false if the API is missing or changes are disabled (nil if the argument is nil).

regenerateWeatherMap.desc: Regenerates the weather map (cloud shape) with a seed. Called with a random seed on every level load.

seed.desc: Seed, rounded and clamped to 0..2147483647; random if nil.

returns.desc: Normalized seed used (absent if the C++ API is missing).

setCloudCoverByID.desc: Sets the coverage of a specific CloudLayer (no hook, no enableChanges check).

setCloudExposureByID.desc: Deprecated: logs a warning, does nothing.

setCloudWindByID.desc: Sets windSpeed of a specific CloudLayer.

getCloudHeightByID.desc: height field of a specific CloudLayer.

setCloudHeightByID.desc: Sets the height field of a specific CloudLayer.

getCloudWindDirectionByID.desc: Wind direction of a specific CloudLayer.

setCloudWindDirectionByID.desc: Sets the wind direction of a specific CloudLayer.

....desc: A vec3 or two numbers x, y.

setCloudAltitudeKmByID.desc: Sets the altitude (km) of a specific CloudLayer.

getCloudCirrusAltitudeKmByID.desc: Cirrus altitude (km) of a specific CloudLayer.

setCloudCirrusAltitudeKmByID.desc: Sets the cirrus altitude of a specific CloudLayer.

getCloudCirrusCoverageByID.desc: Cirrus coverage of a specific CloudLayer.

setCloudCirrusCoverageByID.desc: Sets the cirrus coverage of a specific CloudLayer.

getCloudCirrusDensityByID.desc: Cirrus density of a specific CloudLayer.

setCloudCirrusDensityByID.desc: Sets the cirrus density of a specific CloudLayer.

setFogDensity.desc: Sets LevelInfo.fogDensity (raw value, very small: the UI uses 1000x this value) and cancels an ongoing transition. Emits onEnvironmentChanged({fogDensity}) with the raw value.

setFogDensityOffset.desc: Deprecated: logs a warning, does nothing.

setFogAtmosphereHeight.desc: Sets LevelInfo.FogAtmosphereHeight. Does not emit onEnvironmentChanged and ignores enableChanges.

fogHeight.desc: Fog atmosphere height (UI range up to ~2000, inferred from lerpRanges).

setPrecipitation.desc: Sets Precipitation.numDrops (number of rain drops/particles). No hook, no enableChanges check.

getPrecipitation.desc: Number of drops of the Precipitation object.

getTemperatureK.desc: Sea level air temperature currently sent to the engine.

returns.desc: Kelvins (0.0 until the curve has been evaluated).

setTemperatureProfile.desc: Creates an override of the day's temperature curve: shifts the curve to reach the average, then stretches the troughs/peaks to reach min and max. Values clamped to -50..60 °C. Ignored if enableChanges(false) or invalid table.

profile.desc: {averageC?, minC?, maxC?} in °C; at least one finite numeric field required.

resetTemperatureProfile.desc: Removes the override and goes back to the level's temperature curve.

saveTireMarks.desc: Saves the tire marks to a file.

loadTireMarks.desc: Loads tire marks from a file.

reloadGroundModels.desc: Resets then reloads all ground models: art/groundmodels.json, then the *.json files of <level>/groundModels/. ASPHALT is submitted first (index 0), then the others in alphabetical order. Names are uppercased and truncated to 30 characters if > 31.

dumpGroundModels.desc: Writes groundmodels_dump.json with the physical properties of each registered ground model (friction, resistance, fluid density…). Debug tool.

onInit.desc: Alias of reset: called when the extension loads.

onClientPreStartMission.desc: Hook before a level starts: re-reads the temperature curve, removes the override, reloads the ground models.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook after level start: stores the initial state (init_env), adds authoredDayLength to it then re-applies it.

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook at level start: clears the object cache, lists the night lights, applies the wind and regenerates the weather map with a random seed.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook at level end: stops the TimeOfDay clock, resets the wind to 0, clears the night lights and calls reset.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: advances the state transition, applies the night lights and updates the effective temperature according to the time.

onFilesChanged.desc: Hook called when files change: if a loaded ground model file is modified, calls reset() and be:reloadCollision().

files.desc: List of entries with a filename field.

onSerialize.desc: Save hook before extensions reload: returns {groundWind}.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook: re-applies the saved ground wind.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: re-applies the ground wind to vehicles (alias of applyGroundWind, receives the vehicle id but ignores it).

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: re-applies the ground wind (alias of applyGroundWind).

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Hook on editor exit: clears the cache and lists the night lights again.

onEditorBeforeSaveLevel.desc: Hook before the level is saved in the editor: turns off the night lights so they are not saved turned on.

onEditorAfterSaveLevel.desc: Hook after saving: restores the state of the night lights.
